value: About ZYNAVAWhy ZYNAVA ExistsThe supplement market presents a paradox: we have more options than ever before, yet individuals often feel more confused, not less. ZYNAVA exists to solve this problem by giving you simple tools to explore supplement options, build a supplement plan, and ask supplement questions — all in one place.We recognize that people don't need more supplement options — they need clarity. That means tools that help you understand what you're taking, find fair prices, and make decisions based on your own goals, not marketing budgets or brand popularity.What ZYNAVA DoesZynava is an independent supplement search and price-comparison engine with three core tools. First, you can search supplement options and compare prices across multiple retailers. Second, you can build a personalized supplement plan based on your lifestyle, diet, and budget. Third, you can ask supplement questions with our AI advisor for non-medical, educational guidance.You can also chat with our AI advisor to ask questions about supplements, health goals, or wellness tips. Everything is free, no sign-up required, and no personal information needed.We do not sell or manufacture supplements. When you buy through links on Zynava, we may earn an affiliate commission at no extra cost to you — this never affects how results are ranked. Our role is informational and educational.Trust, Transparency, and SafetyZYNAVA is not a medical platform. We do not diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease or medical condition. We do not replace conversations with qualified healthcare professionals. We do not provide personalized medical advice.We commit to honest, evidence-informed guidance. We use transparent language — "may support," not guaranteed results. Accuracy over sales. We never promise outcomes.Before using any supplement, especially if you have existing health conditions, take medications, are pregnant or breastfeeding, or have specific medical concerns, please consult with a qualified healthcare professional.Our MissionZYNAVA's mission is to empower individuals with simple, AI-powered tools that support informed supplement decisions. We believe that supplement guidance should be independent, evidence-informed, and free from sales pressure.We are committed to transparency, accuracy, and user-first design.
